page:
Expo integration for API routes in Expo apps. Available from Expo SDK 50 and App Router v3. Create app/[...slugs]+api.ts file. Define Elysia server. Export Elysia.fetch with HTTP method names (GET, POST). Treat as normal Expo API route.
Questions: What Expo versions support Elysia? How do you create API routes? What export pattern is used?

sections.manifest:
Prefix configuration for non-root servers. If Elysia server placed in app/api/[...slugs]+api.ts, annotate prefix as /api. Syntax: `new Elysia({ prefix: '/api' })`. Ensures proper routing regardless of placement.
Questions: When do you need prefix? How does it affect routes?

Eden Treaty integration for end-to-end type safety similar to tRPC. Export type from Elysia server: `export type app = typeof app`. Create Treaty client: `treaty<app>('localhost:3000/api')`. Use in both server and client components. Type safety from frontend to backend.
Questions: How do you set up Eden Treaty? What type must you export?

Deployment options: directly use API route with normal Elysia deployment or use experimental Expo server runtime. expo export command creates optimized build at dist/server/_expo/functions/[...slugs]+api.js. Expo Functions treated as Edge functions (no port allocation). Use Expo function adapters: Express, Netlify, Vercel.
Questions: How do you deploy Expo Elysia apps? What are Expo Functions?
